{{Quote|What is your name?''"<br />"''Jedi.|Darth Vader and Dendro|<ref name="THB" />}}
'''Dendro''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] apprenticed to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Hylon]] during the final [[Galactic Standard Calendar|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Dendro and his Master survived the [[Order 66/Legends|initial stages]] of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], which was [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|ordered]] by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. A few [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after Palpatine declared himself [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Dendro and Hylon joined forces with the [[Ovoni]], natives of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Otavon XII]]. After a strike force of Ovoni were [[Battle of Otavon XII|defeated]] while attacking [[Tremor Base]]&mdash;an Imperial station constructing [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]]&mdash;the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] tracked Dendro and a small group of Ovoni in the forest. The Jedi confronted the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]], but was ultimately killed by Vader.

==Biography==
{{Quote|You will not defeat me.''"<br />"''By surviving this long, I already have.|Darth Vader and Dendro|<ref name="THB" />}}
[[File:Dendro_vs_Vader.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Dendro fights against Darth Vader.]]
Dendro, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During that [[Time/Legends|time]], he became the [[Ovoni]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Hylon]]'s [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]].<ref name="THB" /> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|issued]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], compelling all [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]]. Shortly after, Palpatine declared himself [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of the new [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

Dendro and Hylon survived the initial stages of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] and joined forces with the Ovoni natives on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Otavon XII]]. A few [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after Order 66 was issued, the Ovoni staged an [[Battle of Otavon XII|assault]] on the local Imperial station [[Tremor Base]], which constructed [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]]. The assault team was defeated by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and the Imperial forces under his command. Dendro and five Ovoni fled through the forest, planning to go to a river and make their way back to [[Mount Dijandi]], where Hylon was waiting.<ref name="THB" />

However, Vader located Dendro and the small group of Ovoni. The Dark [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] dispatched the natives and engaged Dendro in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]]. During the duel, Vader injured Dendro by [[Shiim/Legends|slashing]] the Jedi's left [[Limb/Legends|leg]]. Vader attempted to learn Dendro's identity, but the Jedi refused to tell the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] his name. After Dendro threw a [[Lantern/Legends|lantern]] at Vader, the Dark Lord used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|push]] the Padawan back. Vader grasped Dendro by his neck and removed his hood, recognizing that Dendro was a Padawan due to his distinctive [[Padawan braid/Legends|braid]]. When Dendro was asked where his Master was, he replied that Hylon was on his way to a [[Starship/Legends|starship]], and that Vader would never find the Jedi Master once he escaped the planet. The Padawan was thrown to the ground and was killed by Vader, who used both his own and Dendro's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to murder the Jedi. Shortly after Dendro's death, the Dark Lord located Hylon on Mount Dijandi, defeating and slaying the Jedi Master.<ref name="THB" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Your will is strong. But not strong enough.|Darth Vader, to Dendro, before killing the Padawan|<ref name="THB" />}}
[[File:Hylon.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Hylon, Dendro's Jedi Master]]
After the initiation of the Great Jedi Purge, the Dendro was willing to aid the Ovoni people against the forces of the Galactic Empire on Otavon XII. When [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader confronted Dendro in the forests of Otavon XII, the Jedi refused to reveal either his identity or the whereabouts of his Jedi Master, Hylon. Before killing Dendro, Vader remarked that the Jedi's will was strong. Dendro wore a set of [[brown]] [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]] and used a lightsaber containing a [[blue]] [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]].<ref name="THB" />

==Powers and abilities==
When the Great Jedi Purge was initiated, Dendro managed to evade the Imperial forces along with his Master, Hylon. He used a lightsaber during combat; however, he was not able to defeat Darth Vader when he engaged the Sith Lord in a duel.<ref name="THB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dendro appeared in the standalone [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] [[Purge – The Hidden Blade|''Star Wars: Purge: The Hidden Blade'']], written by [[W. Haden Blackman]], penciled by [[Chris Scalf]], and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="THB" /> on [[April 7]], [[2010]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54466/star_wars_purge_-_the_hidden_blade_2010_1|text=Star Wars: Purge - The Hidden Blade (2010) #1}}</ref>
